verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for a simulator, but the evidence never documents a rule or trigger mechanism that fires actions automatically on events. What it does show are developer building blocks: custom C++ plugins, gz-transport publish/subscribe messaging, and a configuration script that chooses which programs and plugins to run. None of these is a user-definable event-rule capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
